formulaBlock.normalization: Packet list already normalized (synonym variants are single entries); positions cited are normalized one-based positions (ID-2), identical to the packet order.

cleansingStrength.rationale: `moderate` by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2, prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine@3, no reinforcing strong anionic. Lauryl Lactate@4 is an emollient ester, not a lactylate surfactant (no C3 class); Laureth-4@9 is an ethoxylate (no route).

conditioningLevel.rationale: `high` by C2: prominent payload lipid Lauryl Lactate@4 (emollient ester, 6.3) in place of the early silicone, cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@5, pearlizing Glycol Distearate@6, deliberate humectant Glycerin@17 (own entry, R11). Confidence moderate: the lipid element rests on reading Lauryl Lactate as a payload emollient ester rather than a light weak refatter (which would not satisfy C2 and give `moderate`), and the only humectant is near the end of the list.

wLineRecord.testedCandidate: Parfum@7 is the only candidate up to the cap: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) nothing between it and the cap -> plausible; W-line = cap

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate — one guar plus one material emollient ester; no silicone, no protein.
weightPotential.persistence: low-to-moderate — Lauryl Lactate is a light, fairly polar emollient ester; guar coacervate deposition; no persistent silicone.
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate — C1 ether-sulfate chassis with a betaine buffer.
weightPotential.counterevidence: W-RICH holds for weight (material Lauryl Lactate@4 converging with guar@5), which argues for `high`; but reset is not limited.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Two interacting routes (guar + light ester) plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue under an ordinary reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not `high`: W-RICH requires limited reset (resetCapacity weak) and reset here is moderate; the convergence route's two families are a single guar and a light, low-persistence ester, not plausibly persistent systems that outrun an ordinary C1 reset. Not `low`: two families including a prominent material lipid (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: W-RICH counter-signal; Lauryl Lactate family reading (payload_lipid vs weak_refatter) and doses unknown.
weightPotential.rationale: `moderate`: W-RICH present but reset not limited; convergence light. Neighbor `high` (W-RICH counter-signal).

careDirection.limitation: late humectant; comfort actives (Allantoin@11, Bisabolol@12) and Menthol@8 suggest a scalp role that only claims can confirm

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Claims are hidden in the blind pass; focus is claim-led (7.2) and cannot be set from the formula alone.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: claim direction null (hidden). Placeholder `general` (7.1 honest fallback) until reveal; formula routes recorded for reconciliation (3.2).
focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional (formula-only): `general` because no claim is visible; the formula care-direction verdict is recorded before claims (7.3) and the neighbor names the most plausible formula-compatible focus.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: empty default considered; no distinct positioning visible (claims hidden), so no secondary can be selected (Section 8).
focusSecondary.rationale: Provisional (formula-only): `[]` — Section 8 requires distinct exact-product positioning, which is hidden in the blind pass.

usageRole.rationale: Provisional (formula-only): default `regular` (Section 9); every non-default trigger needs a moderate/high-graded claim or direction, all hidden in the blind pass. cleansingStrength `moderate` fixes which triggers remain possible: `frequent` possible with U2 wording; `alternating` impossible (not strong); `treatment` impossible (no active).

scalpComfortTarget.mildBase: excluded — Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 is a prominent strong anionic
scalpComfortTarget.rationale: `not_targeted`, decided by the formula: CSA FAILS — no E4 comfort route is prominent (Allantoin@11 and Bisabolol@12 are after Parfum@7) and no E4 humectant/refatting route is prominent (Glycerin@17 late; Lauryl Lactate@4 is an emollient ester, which the humectant/refatting list excludes, and was rejected by R18). MB: excluded — Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 is a prominent strong anionic. Without a listed prominent route and without MB, even an explicitly positioned product is `not_targeted` (Section 10), so positioning cannot change the value; a sensitive/dry claim at reveal would trigger S-FAIL with the missing route named. unlisted_route_candidate:Lauryl Lactate (named per E4/CSA). Counter-signal Menthol@8 (cooling, just after the E3 point).

dandruffSupport.rationale: `not_supported`: the complete INCI contains none of Piroctone Olamine, Climbazole, Selenium Sulfide or Selenium Disulfide (Section 11, DS1).
